items.title: Verizon (VZ) Gets $1.5 Billion Fiber Backing From Bain And Tillman
items.summary: Bain Capital and Tillman Global Holdings are investing $1.5b in Eaton Fiber to accelerate Verizon’s fiber broadband rollout. The plan includes Eaton Fiber’s acquisition of Ripple Fiber to expand Verizon’s network footprint and customer reach. The partnership is aimed at supporting Verizon Communications (NYSE:VZ) as it builds out fiber infrastructure across the US. items.title: The Top 5 Analyst Questions From Verizon’s Q2 Earnings Call
items.summary: Verizon’s second quarter was met with a positive market reaction, despite revenue coming in below Wall Street expectations.
